original: The fare rule allows a passenger to interrupt a journey on a single ticket.
paraphrase: Under the fare rule, a passenger may break up a trip made on one ticket.
foil: The fare rule forbids a passenger to interrupt a journey on a single ticket.
change: Interrupting the journey changes from permitted to forbidden.

original: Engaging the latch prevents the drawer from sliding open.
paraphrase: With the latch engaged, the drawer cannot slide open.
foil: Engaging the latch does not prevent the drawer from sliding open.
change: The foil denies that the engaged latch stops the drawer from opening.

original: The tally excludes jars with cracked lids.
paraphrase: Jars whose lids are cracked are left out of the count.
foil: The tally includes jars with cracked lids.
change: Jars with cracked lids switch from outside the tally to inside it.

original: Renewing a locker rental leaves the access code unchanged.
paraphrase: The same access code carries over when the locker rental is renewed.
foil: Renewing a locker rental changes the access code.
change: Renewal switches from preserving the code to changing it.

original: A missing signature invalidates the delivery receipt.
paraphrase: The delivery receipt is invalid if the signature is absent.
foil: A missing signature does not invalidate the delivery receipt.
change: The foil denies that the absence of the signature invalidates the receipt.

original: The trial found a difference in drying time between the two glazes.
paraphrase: In the trial, the two glazes took different amounts of time to dry.
foil: The trial found no difference in drying time between the two glazes.
change: The trial's finding changes from a difference to no difference.

original: The north branch lent its spare scanner to the south branch.
paraphrase: The south branch borrowed a spare scanner from the north branch.
foil: The south branch lent its spare scanner to the north branch.
change: The two branches exchange the roles of lender and borrower.

original: The inspector used the east gauge to check the west gauge.
paraphrase: The inspector checked the west gauge against the east gauge.
foil: The inspector used the west gauge to check the east gauge.
change: The reference gauge and the gauge under inspection exchange roles.

original: The partner reimbursed the studio for the framing costs.
paraphrase: The studio got its framing costs back from the partner.
foil: The studio reimbursed the partner for the framing costs.
change: The party issuing the reimbursement becomes the party receiving it.

original: The diagram shows the small gear driving the large gear.
paraphrase: In the diagram, the large gear receives its drive from the small gear.
foil: The diagram shows the large gear driving the small gear.
change: The driving gear and the driven gear exchange roles.

original: The survey ranks the canal route above the ridge route for accessibility.
paraphrase: In the survey's accessibility ranking, the ridge route falls below the canal route.
foil: The survey ranks the ridge route above the canal route for accessibility.
change: Reversing the routes changes which route ranks higher.

original: The museum hired the guild to appraise the bronze figure.
paraphrase: The guild was hired by the museum to value the bronze figure.
foil: The guild hired the museum to appraise the bronze figure.
change: The commissioning organization and the hired appraiser exchange roles.

original: The clock keeps its hands moving during a power cut by drawing on a battery.
paraphrase: When the power fails, the clock runs its hands on battery power.
foil: The clock keeps its hands moving during a power cut by unwinding a spring.
change: The hands keep moving in both accounts, but their energy source changes from a battery to a spring.

original: The separator removes the steel beads from the mixture with a magnet.
paraphrase: A magnet in the separator picks the steel beads out of the mixture.
foil: The separator removes the steel beads from the mixture with a sieve.
change: The separation method changes from magnetic attraction to sieving.

original: The canopy cools the bench by blocking sunlight.
paraphrase: The canopy shades the bench and thereby keeps it cooler.
foil: The canopy cools the bench by spraying mist.
change: The account attributes cooling to mist instead of shade.

original: The cart slows on the test track because its brake pads rub against the wheels.
paraphrase: Friction between the brake pads and the wheels slows the cart on the test track.
foil: The cart slows on the test track because its wheels climb an incline.
change: The proposed cause of deceleration switches from braking friction to an uphill slope.

original: The archive dates the photograph by matching the skyline to dated maps.
paraphrase: To determine the photograph's date, the archive compares its skyline with maps of known dates.
foil: The archive dates the photograph by matching its watermark to dated samples.
change: The dating method uses different evidence, replacing skyline maps with watermark samples.

original: The bakery shortened the queue by adding a second cashier.
paraphrase: Bringing in another cashier reduced the length of the line at the bakery.
foil: The bakery shortened the queue by moving prepaid orders to a pickup shelf.
change: The queue shrinks through an added cashier in one account and through separate pickup in the other.

original: The tank alarm sounds when the water level rises above the upper mark.
paraphrase: A rise in water level past the upper mark triggers the tank alarm.
foil: The tank alarm sounds when the water level rises to the upper mark.
change: Reaching the upper mark triggers the foil's alarm, while the original specifies passing the mark.

original: The clerk stamps the form before the applicant signs it.
paraphrase: By the time the applicant signs the form, the clerk has already stamped it.
foil: The clerk stamps the form after the applicant signs it.
change: The order of stamping and signing reverses.

original: A team qualifies if it finishes both stages within the time limit.
paraphrase: Finishing the two stages within the allotted time is enough for a team to qualify.
foil: A team qualifies if it finishes at least one stage within the time limit.
change: The stated sufficient condition switches from finishing both stages to finishing at least one.

original: The depot counts parcels left on the platform at noon.
paraphrase: At midday, the depot tallies the parcels still on the platform.
foil: The depot counts parcels left on the platform at midnight.
change: The specified parcel count moves from midday to midnight.

original: The discount applies to orders of more than ten whole rolls.
paraphrase: Orders containing eleven or more whole rolls qualify for the discount.
foil: The discount applies to orders of ten or more whole rolls.
change: The foil lowers the stated minimum by one whole roll, making an order of exactly ten eligible.

original: The courtyard lights stay on until the last stall closes.
paraphrase: The courtyard remains lit up to the closing of the final stall.
foil: The courtyard lights stay on until the first stall closes.
change: The lighting period ends at the first closing instead of the last.
